descripcion: A native Android assistant that actually does things. Voice in, real actions out — calls, messages, camera, app control — on top of a hand-drawn HUD. No account, no JARVIS server, no telemetry. Every AI feature runs on a key you own, and every permission is requested at the moment it is needed.
